name: Kouitten -Dansou Bakunyuu Joshi no 3-nenkan ni Wataru Zecchou Choukyou-
original_name: 紅一点 —男装爆乳女子の3年間に渡る絶頂調教—
source:
Aoi is a pretty girl attending a girls-only private school.
As intelligent as she is beautiful, she still ranks second to her idiot brother who is sure to doom the family if he inherits everything.
What's a daughter to do? Aoi decides to crossdress, attend her brother's school, and graduate pretending to be a boy.
It will be a grueling three years of secrecy... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE102775.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
葵是一名就读于女子私立学校的漂亮女孩。她既聪明又美丽，却仍然排在那个愚蠢的哥哥之后；如果让哥哥继承一切，家族必将毁灭。女儿该怎么办？葵决定女扮男装，进入哥哥的学校，伪装成男孩毕业。
这将是秘密度过的艰苦三年……

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE102775.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
